architecture.custom_infrastructure: evaluation/ ~4684 LOC, verification/ ~4566 LOC, orchestration/hermes/ ~4215 LOC, specification/ ~1217 LOC; total custom Python/Bash ~9468 LOC
architecture.evaluation_core: evaluation/commandcode/core.py is the frozen v0.2.3 Command Code Evaluation Core. It is READ-ONLY in this wave: phase derivation, clock model, failure taxonomy and repair attribution are all outside WAVE1A's write surface.
architecture.phase_mapping: evaluation/commandcode/phase_rules.json is a deterministic ordered rule table. core.py::PhaseMapper matches the FIRST rule whose declared conditions (tools, tool_regex, subagent_regex, command_regex, path_regex, result_regex) all match an effective item of a turn. phase, subphase, confidence, time_class and wait_tag are fully data-driven, which is why the two known classification defects are fixable without touching core.py.
architecture.hermes_adapter: orchestration/hermes/evaluation_adapter/hermes_session_source.py normalises a completed pinned Hermes root session (state.db) into a Command Code v3-shaped JSONL shim so the canonical finalizer and the frozen core are reused verbatim. Its HERMES_TOOL_ALIAS maps terminal->shell_command, patch->edit_file, search_files->grep.
architecture.contract_guard: orchestration/hermes/evaluation_adapter/contract_guard.py is the frozen P0B-CLOSE pre_tool_call write guard. It reads implementation-contract.json (allowed_paths/forbidden_paths), project-context.json (path_classes/source_root) and manifest.json (sha256 integrity). It is READ-ONLY in this wave.
architecture.specification_compiler: specification/compiler/{spec_lib,build_contract,hash_manifest,validate_package}.py exist and are real. M4 bypassed the compiler; restoring it is WAVE2. WAVE1A reuses only its hashing/path helpers and must not modify it.
architecture.hermes_profile: /home/zhong/.hermes/profiles/android-stack/config.yaml registers two shell hooks: pre_tool_call -> contract_guard.py (fail_closed) and on_session_finalize -> hermes-autofinalizer-hook.sh. Both are live and allowlisted. WAVE1A must not change this file.
architecture.pinned_hermes: /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent (HERMES-LOCK.json commit af90026aa09949579bd423d24def3d38f743cde0) is the authoritative source for the shell-hook payload schema. READ-ONLY.

guard.semantics: inside an allowed path -> ALLOW; inside a forbidden path -> BLOCK; inside the project but unlisted -> BLOCK (UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL_CLOSED); outside the project root -> ALLOW labelled OUT_OF_CONTRACT_SCOPE.
guard.known_limitation: The guard cannot enforce the prohibitions on config.yaml, /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent/** or any other path outside source_root. Those are declared-by-contract and proven by pre/post sha256 equality.
